title: Envelope Sound Picks
heading: The Envelope: pick the track
intro: One Suno track carries the line, the stings and the music (Kai's rule for shorts). Four genuinely different sounds, two takes each, all about 15 s. Each opens in Suno. Pick one and note what to change; the rough cut is built to your pick.

sections.lede: Each idea in a line; the full prompts are in the repo.

groups.title: The track
groups.line: The line: "They're going to print the money and the weapon sales will still happen anyway, everything else is a distraction."
